rigType: Hierarchical transform-node rig (not a skinned mesh)
notes: Animation clips are embedded in the GLB and target named transform nodes.
The model uses a hierarchical transform-node rig, not a Mixamo-ready deformable skin.
The static PNG fallback is a separately generated image and is not pixel-identical to the GLB.
Install the three package before rendering StudioGuide.tsx.
runtime: StudioGuide.tsx decompresses the asset with DecompressionStream before GLTFLoader parsing.
